task.description: Implement section 9 of the now-gate-approved lib/letflow/design/iss0732-promotion-apply-assertion-gate.md (the OQ-2 amendment) on top of your own earlier commit 4efff094. This closes a follow-up gap found by SECURITY-REVIEWER: verify_rehearsed/2 (which you already added) must ALSO reject an in-progress (status: :running) assertion run, not just an assertions_failed > 0 one -- the amendment's chosen fix is `status not in [:running]`, checked in ADDITION to (never instead of) the existing assertions_failed == 0 check, plus a new, distinct :assertion_run_in_progress error reason mapped to its own 409 in promotions.ex, per the design's exact ordering (status check as new step 3, assertions_failed check renumbered to step 4). Do not weaken or remove anything from your earlier commit -- this is additive. Update test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs's insert_passing_assertion_run!/3 helper if needed to make sure it inserts a :passed (not :running) row so the 3 existing happy-path fixtures you already fixed keep passing under the new stricter check -- and add new regression coverage for the in-progress-rehearsal rejection path itself (a review whose latest assertion run is status: :running gets rejected with :assertion_run_in_progress, not silently accepted). Run mix compile --warnings-as-errors and the targeted test files again, quote real output.

A review whose latest assertion run has status: :teardown_failed and assertions_failed == 0 is STILL accepted (this must not regress -- proves the fix did not become status == :passed-only)
The 3 existing happy-path fixtures (insert_passing_assertion_run!/3 call sites) still pass
